title: Stairway to Heaven
composer: Jimmy Page & Robert Plant / Led Zeppelin
description: The iconic opening arpeggio and haunting verse melody. Instantly recognisable and deeply satisfying on piano.
generalTip: Right hand melody and arpeggio. Key of A minor (no sharps/flats in signature, but watch for G# and F# black keys!).

sections.label: The Iconic Arpeggio
tips: 🪜 Start on low A below Middle C, then climb through C, E, and high A (octave leap!)
🖤 ^g means G# (black key just below A) — this descending bass note creates the iconic tension
👆 Finger guide: A(1) c(2) e(3) a(5) then ^g(4) e(3) c(2) ^g(4)

sections.label: The Resolution
tips: 🍃 =f means natural F (white key). Feel the music soften as it lands on the F chord
🎵 Notice how bars 3–4 resolve back to the home note A — tension released
🔄 Combine Sections 1 and 2 and you can play the world's most famous rock intro!

sections.label: "All That Glitters"
tips: 🎤 "There's a lady who's sure all that glitters is gold / And she's buying a stairway to heaven"
🎵 The melody moves by gentle steps: E E E D · C B A — sing the words as you play
✨ Let each phrase breathe before starting the next line
